item.text: I’ll first check what’s already in `/work`, then build the registration app to fit the existing project structure.

`/work` is empty, so I’m creating a self-contained app with separate HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files. The navigation will switch between the four views, and course selection will flow into registration and the student’s registered-course table.

Built the responsive course registration app in [index.html](/work/index.html), [styles.css](/work/styles.css), and [app.js](/work/app.js).

It includes Home, Course Catalog, Registration, and Student Profile views; course search and filters; add, remove, and save actions; a registration form with confirmation modal; and a registered-course table. The colorful layout adapts to mobile screens, and course selections persist in the browser.

I haven’t run it in a browser.
